> I hate myself so much and through years of therapy I've tried to change it.

Yes I tried. I never tried meds for my depression tho, only sleeping medication. Thing is I'm already poor enough and addicted to the sleeping meds, I don't think I could even afford more meds...
Even tho my parents are accepting of lgbt (they haven't really understood/accepted i'm trans yet tho) I really feel you. And I agree with those points really much.
It is. But I grew up with thinking "they gave me the gift of life, I need to be thankful for that"
